pages.brief: Olive the owl sitting calmly on a log beside a pond on a still day.
A sudden gust of wind knocking a pot and a cap over near a pond, Olive the owl noticing.
Olive the owl staying alert, watching wind pick up over a pond.
Olive the owl tucking herself into a sheltered gap between two rocks by a pond.
Olive the owl staying put in a sheltered gap as wind and rain sweep over a pond outside.
Wind and rain easing over a pond, water calming, light returning.
Olive the owl stepping out of a gap into calm, still air by a pond, settled and unbothered.
